gitCommit.subject: authz: remove inert permission-flag fields from code (pv9 PR8, us3d code-contract) (#242)
gitCommit.body:
authz: remove inert permission-flag fields from code (pv9 PR8, us3d code-contract) (#242)

* refactor(ui): MemberList/InviteForm/item views off inert permission flags (purses-us3d)

- MemberList: drop per-flag permission badges; keep role badge only
- InviteForm: remove PermissionCheckboxes + flag form fields + flag payload; POST only email
- InviteForm.test: assert email-only payload, no flags in POST body
- ItemDetailPage: derive canDeletePhotos from membership existence, not canDeletePhotos flag
- ItemDetailPage.test: any curator now sees delete control (matches photos:write = member-or-owner)
- POST /api/collections: owner bootstrap creates membership with role only (no all-true flags)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* refactor(authz): remove inert flag fields from types + repos + owner bootstrap (purses-us3d)

- domain.ts: remove 9 flag fields from CollectionMembership, 8 from Invitation
- IMembershipRepository: create/createIfAbsent input DTOs drop all flag params
- IInvitationRepository: create input DTO drops all flag params
- MembershipRepository impl: toInsertValues + mapToMembership stripped of flags
- InvitationRepository impl: create insert + mapToInvitation stripped of flags
- server/api/invitations.ts: already clean (flags not accepted since PR3)
- server/api/members.ts: already clean (flags use DB defaults since PR3)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* feat(db): 0007 drop inert permission-flag columns (purses-us3d)

- schema.ts: remove 9 boolean flag columns from membershipsTable (can_manage_collection,
  can_invite_members, can_add_items, can_delete_items, can_edit_metadata, can_add_photos,
  can_delete_photos, can_sort, can_view_outputs)
- schema.ts: remove 8 boolean flag columns from invitationsTable (same minus can_delete_items)
- drizzle/0007_absent_firebrand.sql: auto-generated DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS x17
  (8 on invitations + 9 on memberships — no other diff)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* test: drop inert-flag seeds/assertions (purses-us3d)

Strip all flag props from MembershipRepository.create() and InvitationRepository.create()
calls across 17 test files and e2e/fixtures/seed.ts:

- seed.ts: seedFullCollection member + invitation creates: role only
- authz-flag-security: rewrite 3 tests — assert role/status/email invariants, not flag fields
- invitations-routes: seedInvitation helper + 3 PATCH tests: assert status not canSort/canDeletePhotos
- collection-invitations-routes: addMember helper drops canInviteMembers override; seedInvitation
  drops flags; happy-path removes canInviteMembers assertion; two 403 tests simplified
- item-photo-routes: 3 membership creates stripped; 4 test names updated; stale comment updated
- lifecycle-routes: POST body drops canSort/canViewOutputs; membership match asserts role not canSort
- core-routes: 2 membership creates stripped + stale comment fixed
- role-constraint: raw schema insert drops flag columns
- 9 other integration tests: membership/invitation creates stripped of flag props

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* refactor(ui): delete dead PermissionCheckboxes component (purses-us3d)

No callers after the invite form went email-only under the role model.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* refactor(authz): PR8 is code-contract only — defer the 0007 column drop to a separate deploy

Two-deploy expand/contract split: vercel-build runs db:migrate at build time while the
old deployment is still live, and the repos' bare .select() names every schema column —
so dropping the inert flag columns IN THIS deploy would 500 the still-live old code's
membership/invitation reads for the build window. This PR ships only the code that STOPS
referencing the columns (schema/types/repos/UI/owner-bootstrap); the DB keeps the now-inert
columns. A follow-up PR runs the 0007 DROP once this column-free code is live (then the drop
is safe). Verified: fresh DB at 0006 (columns present) + this code → full DB tier 466 green.
Also: comment-rot fixes (ItemPhotoCarousel, item-photo-routes test) + members screenshot surface.

Refs: purses-us3d

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* docs(api): pv9 PR8 — inert flag fields removed (code-contract); 0007 drop deferred to a follow-up deploy

Refs: purses-us3d

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* chore(graphify): refresh after pv9 PR8 (node shrink; --force)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* docs(arch): pv9 PR8 us3d split + correct the auto-migrate-on-deploy fact

vercel-build auto-runs db:migrate (decision 17 wrongly said 0006 was a manual step);
this is why the destructive flag-column drop is split into a second deploy.

Refs: purses-us3d

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

membership/invitation reads for the build window. This PR ships only the code that STOPS
referencing the columns (schema/types/repos/UI/owner-bootstrap); the DB keeps the now-inert
columns. A follow-up PR runs the 0007 DROP once this column-free code is live (then the drop
is safe). Verified: fresh DB at 0006 (columns present) + this code → full DB tier 466 green.
